title: Koko Pimentel endorses UAE diplomat for UN chief post

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former Senate President and representative to the Inter-Parliamentary Union Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel expressed support on Tuesday for Emirati diplomat Lana Zaki Nusseibeh in her bid to become secretary-general of the United Nations (UN). Nusseibeh, the UAE’s Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, advocates a two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. As the UAE’s ambassador to the UN, Nusseibeh helped ensure the delivery of humanitarian aid to Gaza amid Israeli bombardments. “As a former Senate President who led the Philippine delegation to the Inter-Parliamentary Union and served as chairman of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, I am honored […]...
